d:
The Indian Men’s Hockey Team went head-to-head with Spain in a fiercely contested clash, delivering a match packed with defensive resilience, late drama, and a tense shootout finish.
India looked set for their first win of the season after Maninder Singh produced a moment of brilliance with a fierce reverse hit to hand the Men in Blue the lead in the second quarter. Spain controlled large phases of possession, but Suraj Karkera and the Indian defence stood tall under sustained pressure.
